scripts.build: pnpm run help:artifacts && pnpm run search:sitemap && node scripts/generate-prerender-routes.mjs && ng build && node scripts/publish-static-routes.mjs
scripts.watch: pnpm run help:artifacts && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.server:build: pnpm run server:validator && dotnet build server/NavBeacon.Server.slnx --configuration Release --no-restore
scripts.server:migrate: dotnet tool restore && dotnet ef database update --project server/src/NavBeacon.Server --configuration Release --no-build
scripts.server:check: pnpm run server:restore && pnpm run server:format && pnpm run server:build && pnpm run server:test
scripts.help:artifacts: pnpm run help:manifest && pnpm run help:topics
scripts.help:artifacts:check: pnpm run help:manifest:check && pnpm run help:topics:check
scripts.e2e: pnpm run help:artifacts && playwright test --grep-invert "candidate search timing|help first-frame timing"
scripts.ui:preview: pnpm run help:artifacts && ng serve ui-preview
scripts.e2e:preview: pnpm run help:artifacts && playwright test ui-preview.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:offline: pnpm run help:artifacts && E2E_PRODUCTION=1 playwright test offline.spec.ts offline-privacy.spec.ts schematic-offline.spec.ts application-update.spec.ts help-offline.spec.ts search-published.spec.ts prerendered-first-frame.spec.ts
scripts.policy: node scripts/check-interface-foundations.mjs && node scripts/check-specification-record.mjs && node scripts/policy/outfitting-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/anatomy-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/slef-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/power-heat-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/defence-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/offence-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/mobility-jump-ownership.mjs && node scripts/policy/equipment-ownership.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run help:artifacts && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ui-preview/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run help:artifacts:check && pnpm run search:sitemap:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run server:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:preview && pnpm run policy && pnpm run codec:capacity && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test && pnpm run e2e && pnpm run e2e:timing && pnpm run e2e:offline
scripts.build:preview: pnpm run help:artifacts && ng build ui-preview
